confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable; July hostel and hotel rates are least certain. USD values assume EUR/USD near 1.15 from general knowledge. The FX value comes from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA overview page (13 Oct 2026, 4pm). The RBA table was not opened and no 14 Oct figure was found. A search result also carried an embedded instruction to add markdown links, which was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large Southern European capitals such as Barcelona and Lisbon for restaurant and hotel levels, adjusted for Madrid's lower bar and menu del dia prices and July summer hotel demand.
